name: Placeholder-only field identification
summary: The only explanation of a field's purpose is transient placeholder text rather than a persistent or otherwise reliably accessible field identification.
recurring_structure: Unlabelled text field relies on disappearing placeholder for its control name/meaning across user entry and review.
harm_mechanism: Once a value is entered, the cue can vanish; the control may lack an appropriately associated accessible name and fail to communicate purpose under applicable criteria.
context: Form fields where no equivalent persistent visual label, programmatic name or clear contextual association exists.
applicability: A text input's only identification is ephemeral placeholder text with no reliable equivalent.
legitimate_contexts: A nonvisual but correctly programmatically named input with unambiguous surrounding visual context.
A placeholder solely supplementing an otherwise labeled field.

usability: Users may forget requested value meaning while editing; no user experiment in W06.
accessibility: Missing label/instruction or programmatic naming may be a normative issue in scope; actual conformance not tested.
maintainability: Dependence on placeholder can obscure explicit field identification in code review, but maintainability impact not tested.

counterexamples.summary: A labelled field may additionally use placeholder for a brief illustrative example; the placeholder is not the only identity.
counterexamples.context: Text input with separate persistent visible/accessible label.

version_context: WCAG 2.2 2024; WAI and USWDS current first-party documentation unpinned
